info.title: HabitatOS Pi → SaaS ingestion contract
info.description: Reference implementation. The production URL requires deployment by the SaaS operator.

servers.description: SaaS deployment target; this reference does not verify production deployment

post.summary: Store sensor/command events and acknowledge durable event IDs
post.description: All-or-nothing transaction. Retries with identical events return the same ACK. Empty events are valid heartbeats. Maximum JSON body: 8 MiB.

403.description: Gateway/cage scope denied or simulation disabled

409.description: Event ID or sequence reused with different content

actual_state.title: Actual State
actual_state.description: Unknown physical state; never inferred from an R15 request ACK.
